h1: A digital agency for Amsterdam companies that also builds AI, data and cloud
intro: 22 Signals works with Amsterdam companies as a digital agency and a technology partner at once. We build AI tools, data and cloud systems, websites and apps, then grow them with SEO and GEO, paid media and video. Work is delivered in English, with one Signal Lead and a written scope that sets out every date.

sections.h: Choosing a digital agency: Amsterdam firms often need more than one skill
p: Search for a digital agency, Amsterdam gives you plenty of good options. There are design studios along the canals, performance shops in the Zuidas offices, AI start-ups in Amsterdam Noord and cloud partners near the data centres west of the city. Most of them do one thing well.

The friction starts when a project crosses those lines. A new European headquarters needs a website, a data warehouse, an AI pilot and a launch campaign in the same quarter. Four suppliers means four contracts, four project plans and a lot of time spent passing files between them. We cover all of it with one team, so the website, the data behind it and the campaigns that drive traffic to it are planned together.

sections.h: The Amsterdam market, as we see it
p: Amsterdam punches above its size. Many American and Asian companies run their European headquarters from the city or from Amstelveen and Hoofddorp, close to Schiphol. The European Medicines Agency moved here after Brexit, and several trading and financial firms followed a similar route. Payments and fintech are a real cluster, and so is e-commerce.

The wider Randstad matters too. Goods arrive through Schiphol and the Port of Rotterdam, then move across Europe from distribution centres in places like Venlo and Tilburg. That logistics base creates demand for tracking systems, customer portals and data work that most people never see. On the creative side, Amsterdam has long been a home for international advertising agencies, many of which need extra production or technical capacity when a big brief lands.

sections.h: English first, Dutch where it counts
p: Dutch business culture is direct and comfortable in English. Many Amsterdam teams use English as their working language, especially in international companies. We deliver all work in English, which suits most of our Amsterdam clients.

Customers are a different matter. A Dutch consumer searching for a mortgage adviser or a new bike will usually type in Dutch, and expects the page, the ad and the checkout to be in Dutch too. When a project needs Dutch copy, we arrange localisation with partners and build the site, the campaigns and the search plan around both languages from the start.

sections.h: Rules we plan around in the Netherlands
p: GDPR applies across the EU, and in the Netherlands it is enforced by the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, the Dutch data protection authority. The AP is an active regulator and has issued large fines, including against companies with headquarters in the country. It also coordinates oversight of algorithms in the Netherlands, which matters for any AI work.

The EU AI Act entered into force in 2024, and its obligations are phasing in over several years. The European Accessibility Act has applied to many consumer-facing digital services since June 2025. Cookie consent, Google Consent Mode and data transfers outside the EU also come up on almost every project. We build these into the plan early, keep the legal points general and ask your legal adviser to confirm anything that turns on the details.

sections.h: How we work with Amsterdam teams
p: 22 Signals is a global business solutions company registered in London. Every Amsterdam project starts with a 15-minute call, then discovery and a written roadmap within five to seven days. After that you get one shared channel for updates, review calls booked when your team can make them, and work that we check before it reaches you.

Every project follows the same four steps. Talk is a 15-minute call to see whether we are a fit. Plan is discovery and a written roadmap, delivered in 5 to 7 days. Build is where specialist teams do the work against dates we put in writing. Grow is what comes after launch: measuring, fixing and adding what the numbers show is worth adding. Quotes and invoices can be in euros.

We have worked with more than 30 companies across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe and the UAE. We have shipped more than 30 AI builds, broadcast more than 20 live events and managed more than $1.5M in projects. We would rather show you relevant work on a call than list claims here, and we do not name clients without their permission.

sections.h: Who we are a good fit for
p: We work best with established Amsterdam businesses and ambitious founders who want to move several things forward at once and would rather deal with one team. That might be a scale-up preparing to enter Germany and France, a European headquarters that needs reporting its US parent will trust, or a creative agency that needs a reliable technical partner behind the scenes. If you only need one small task done, a local specialist may suit you better, and we will say so on the first call.
